newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall 2.01 pct on C/A deficit worries.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall 2.01 pct on C/A deficit worries.

text.p: Thai stocks fell 2.01 percent or 19.31 points to 939.92 at 0833 GMT after investors sold stocks across the board on concerns over Thailand's wide current account deficit, brokers said.
"Investors weren't happy with the current account deficit figures just announced," said Virat Tippanontakul of First Asia Securities.

Shortly before the market reopened for the afternoon session, the Bank of Thailand said the September current deficit had widened to a preliminary 30.5 billion baht from a 29.3 billion baht deficit in August.
A central bank spokeswoman said the BOT projects the current account deficit for the entire year to be around 1995 levels of 8.1 percent of gross domestic product.
